title: run.stopped_at_limit@1
description: The supervisor stopped a run at one of its limits (#1409): which limit, its value and, for memory, the reading that passed it. A check whose run it stopped reads INCONCLUSIVE.

subject.description: The record object this event is about.

writer.description: Only the core appends this kind.

actor.description: The person behind it, from the credential.

seq.description: Order within the session: ns since the epoch when the hook started.

log_pos.description: Its position in the event log, assigned by the hub at append.

limit.description: The limit it was stopped at: memory_mb over its whole process tree, or file_mb for one file a process of it wrote.

x-closure.closed: each value is a member of StartSpec.limits, and a run has no other limit
x-closure.reopens: a new major of this schema

max.description: The limit, in MiB, as the run's start set it.

reading.description: For memory_mb, what the scan read over the run's process tree when it passed the limit, in MiB.
